public_rationale: Amazon reported $37.6 billion in AWS sales for January–March 2026, but did not separate Anthropic's and OpenAI's compute charges [e1]. Google's January 27, 2026 post announced H100 support and named Flashpoint and Spotify as Dataflow GPU users [e2]. It did not identify those customers' GPU models or payments [e2]. The AWS total cannot establish the two labs' revenue share, and the Google post cannot establish paid use of the specified GPUs by other customers [e1][e2]. Neither the 20% estimate nor the revenue exclusivity assertion is settled by these disclosures [e1][e2].
limitations: The packet lacks January–March 2026 compute charges for both labs matched to comparable cloud revenue totals at each provider.
The Google post does not verify revenue from another customer using H100, B200 or B300 GPUs during the target quarter [e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The only revenue the millions of H100, B200 and B300 GPUs are generating is compute spend from Anthropic and OpenAI, which he estimates makes up 20% or more of Google, Amazon and Microsoft's cloud revenues.

statement.excerpt: the only revenue they’re generating is compute spend from Anthropic and OpenAI, which I estimate makes up 20% or more of cloud revenues for Google, Amazon, and Microsoft.

from_speaker: compute spend from Anthropic and OpenAI
cloud revenues for Google, Amazon, and Microsoft
our_interpretation: Use January through March 2026, the latest completed quarter publicly reportable before the June 30 post.
Read 20% or more as applying to each named provider; a combined-provider interpretation is also possible.
Treat exclusivity of GPU-generated revenue and the cloud-revenue percentage as separate assertions within this claim.
Author's estimate identifies the measurement basis; it is not a conditional antecedent.
Use recognized cloud revenue and corresponding customer compute charges, not funding, backlog, or annualized run rates.
criteria.support_condition: Matched records show that the specified GPUs generated revenue exclusively from the two labs and that their recognized compute purchases supplied at least 20% of each provider's cloud revenue during the target quarter.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched records show revenue from another customer on the specified GPUs, or establish a below-20% share for a named provider under the stated reading.
